messages:
Ava: Quick q — the /v1/generate endpoint will change default model pinning in the next deploy? I saw a note referencing `model_version` fallback behavior. Does hosted API start returning unpinned latest by default? Need clarity for SDK release.

Sam: Short answer: we plan to introduce a policy layer. Default behavior today stays the same for now, but we'll add an explicit `model_policy` option.

Priya: We must avoid surprising existing users. Any default switch needs a deprecation timeline.

Sam: Plan outline: opt‑in feature flag -> public opt‑in -> default flip after 8 weeks. We'll expose `model_policy` as a body/query param and an optional header `X-Model-Policy`. Values: `pinned`, `recommended`, `latest`.

Jules: Header is convenient for proxies but harder to audit. Can we require body/query param for new clients and keep header as fallback?

Marta: deploy-bot: deploy started for service/api v3.2.0 -> staging :rocket:

Sam: Yes — require explicit `model_policy` param in SDKs. Header support only for enterprise proxies (we'll log it). Default on servers remains current pinned-first behavior until the flip date.

Ava: Customers will want the exact dates and signal in responses. Proposing: announce now, enable opt-in in 2w, public opt-in for 4w, start warning headers at week 6, flip at week 8.

Priya: Add a deprecation header `X-Model-Policy-Deprecation: scheduled-YYYY-MM-DD` during last 4 weeks so integrators can detect upcoming change. Also emit `warning` in body when fallback happens.

Jules: Add `fallback_to_compatible` boolean flag in the request schema so callers can opt into graceful fallback to a compatible model if pinned model is unavailable. That prevents sudden errors.

Ava: Can you drop a sample request/response we can use in the changelog?

Sam: Sure — quick example:

```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "input": "summarize: ...",
  "model": "open-llama-2.1",            // optional pin
  "model_policy": "recommended",      // new param
  "fallback_to_compatible": true
}
```

Response during warn period: HTTP/1.1 200 OK
```json
{
  "model_used": "open-llama-2.1-quant",
  "model_policy_applied": "recommended",
  "warning": "model policy default will change on 2026-05-01; pin your model to avoid changes",
  "output": "..."
}
```

Sam: I'll put an RFC + migration guide together and link the PR here. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/432

Priya: LGTMed on the timeline. Please include a regression test that asserts pinned clients see no behavior change. I can help write it.

Ava: I'll update SDK changelogs and the docs snippet. Ping me when the staging flag is live and when the deploy to canary is scheduled.

Sam: Will do — staging flag expected today, canary next Tue. I'll post follow-ups here with exact dates and release-note copy. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
